description_en: Enables resource group management for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in elastic storage mode V6.0. After this feature is enabled, the resource management mode of the instance switches from resource queues to resource groups
description_zh: 为AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版存储弹性模式6.0实例开启资源组管理，开启后实例的资源管理模式会从资源队列切换到资源组
name: EnableDBResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
